RAADIO KOSW is a collaboration between Scott Wylie and Kieran O'Connor. They started working together on these tracks around 2012. Kieran creates "jams" using drums, guitars and analog synths in his Coromandel studio. He sends these to Scott who then edits the tracks to form a song structure, adding bass, gats, keyboards and vocal lines. Everything is done remotely. The meeting of their different musical styles creates a unique sound—industrial, sonic, nu/pop-metal…a new musical genre perhaps?
